title: All My Little Words

alt_voicings.label: Capo 1 shapes
alt_voicings.note: G Em D C with capo 1 sounds the same

why: A **flat key away from open position**: E-shape barres (A♭, Fm) mixed with A-shape barres (E♭, D♭).
hard_change: **E♭ (A-shape, 6th fret) → D♭ (A-shape, 4th fret)** in half a bar: keep the shape frozen and slide it two frets.
theory: I–vi–V–IV in A♭; the chorus is V–IV–I.
steps: Changes alone, slowly: A♭ → Fm, then E♭ → D♭ as a two-fret slide.
With the record — barre version, or capo 1 with G-shapes if the barres tire you.
